name: Silk and Bamboo
description: Chinese instruments of silk strings and bamboo pipes: erhu, guzheng and pipa, dizi and sheng, with Peking opera gongs and the temple block.
credit: Sounds put together for HO[LO] (CC0): HO[LO] Desk's built-in synths and effects, and the Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (CC0). Each pack keeps its own licence and credit.

source.note: No audio of its own: its sounds play the packs it requires and HO[LO] Desk’s built-in synths.

sounds.name: Erhu
sounds.note: The two-stringed bowed fiddle: a voice-like, sliding tone (coming with the Erhu pack).

sounds.name: Guzheng
sounds.note: The many-stringed zither: shimmering plucks, lovely for glissandi.

sounds.name: Guzheng, Pressed
sounds.note: The guzheng with a deep left-hand vibrato pressed into each note.

sounds.name: Pipa
sounds.note: The pear-shaped lute: held notes become a fast tremolo.

sounds.name: Dizi
sounds.note: The bamboo flute with a buzzing membrane: bright and reedy.

sounds.name: Sheng
sounds.note: The mouth organ of bamboo pipes: each note with its fifth and octave.

sounds.name: Opera Gongs
sounds.note: Peking opera hand gongs: the pitch slides down on low notes and up on high ones.

sounds.name: Temple Block
sounds.note: The hollow wooden block that keeps time.
